output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_customers_2025
FROM (
    SELECT o.customer_id, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_completed_date
    FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
) AS f
WHERE f.first_completed_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND f.first_completed_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: This finds each customer's earliest completed order across all history, then counts the customers whose date falls in 2025. It assumes "completed" means status = 'completed', since no status values or column descriptions were provided. If it should instead mean revenue-counting orders, filter on is_revenue. I didn't use dim_customers.first_order_date because it isn't stated whether it covers only completed orders.
